description:
"Lie down. I'll take good care of you." 

Lee Yeoreum, a 26-year-old corporate newbie, has a crush on Team Leader Seok Dojun. While indulging in self-pleasure while thinking of his face, she gets caught red-handed by Team Leader Seok. 

"Show me yours too. That’s only fair!" 

"Ha... Are you insane?" 

Wait... things are taking a weird turn? 

"You said you wanted to see it. I suppose there's no harm in it. I'll show you." 

With a pretty face hiding a not-so-pretty nature... Seok Dojun whispered like a devil with an angel's face. She tried to use him, but ended up getting thoroughly used instead.
